title: Solomon's Temple: Equipment and Hiram's Work
description: The chapter describes in detail the bronze and gold items made for God's house: the bronze altar, the great Sea resting on twelve oxen, the ten basins for cleansing water, the ten golden lampstands, and the ten tables in the temple hall, as well as the priests' courtyard and the large outer court. Master Hiram completed the casting of the pillars, pomegranates, pots, and bowls on the plain of Jordan between Succoth and Zeredatha, while Solomon provided all the gold utensils for the Most Holy Place and the temple hall.
